question: Which keyboard shortcut can be used to Print the Microsoft Word document?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + P**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + P** is the keyboard shortcut used to print a document in Microsoft Word.
 
• This shortcut opens the Print dialog box, allowing users to select printing options and print the document.
 
• Using keyboard shortcuts can significantly speed up common tasks in Microsoft Word.
 
• Other commonly used shortcuts include **Ctrl + S** for saving a document, **Ctrl + V** for pasting text, and **Ctrl + Z** for undoing the last action.
 
• Familiarity with keyboard shortcuts can improve overall efficiency and productivity when working with documents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microsoft Word** is a widely used word processing software developed by Microsoft.
 
• It offers a range of features to create, edit, format, and print documents.
 
• Microsoft Word is part of the Microsoft Office suite, which includes other applications like Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
 
• Learning and utilizing keyboard shortcuts in Microsoft Word can make document creation and editing more efficient.
 
• Microsoft Word supports various file formats, including .docx, .doc, .pdf, and more.
 
• The software is available on multiple platforms, including Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.
